lede: A few things I've built recently — described at a level that keeps client detail out of it.

items.name: Valuation Review Agent
items.summary: An AI pipeline that reads large scanned valuation reports and extracts the fields an auditor actually needs, chunking and re-assembling documents that are far too long for a single pass.

items.name: Financial Reporting Checklist Agent
items.summary: A guided compliance checklist that branches across for-profit, not-for-profit and special-purpose reporting frameworks, so reviewers only answer the questions that apply to them.

items.name: Letter Generation Pipeline
items.summary: An Alteryx and Python workflow that turns a data extract into hundreds of correctly populated Word letters, replacing a mail-merge process that used to take days.

items.name: This Portfolio
items.summary: A statically built single-page site with tabbed navigation, hash routing and an animated pill indicator — Astro, plain CSS, no UI framework.
